title: Embedding Model Drift & Re-Indexing Zero-Downtime Migration: · Procrustes Orthogonal Linear Transformation
prompt: **Embedding Model Drift & Re-Indexing Zero-Downtime Migration:** You upgrade your production embedding model from `v1` to `v2` across 500 million vectors in production. Because vector spaces of two models are incompatible (up to an orthogonal rotation), how do you execute a blue-green index migration or learn a **Procrustes Orthogonal Linear Transformation** adapter $W$ ($v_2 \approx W v_1$) so you don't have to re-embed all 500M documents at once?
